none: PAS NLM-C4F1B5: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Two Victories issue of 347-348, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust draped diademed and cuirassed right. Reverse description: Two Victories standing facing each other holding wreaths, C between Victories. Reverse inscription: [VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN]. Diameter: 14.5mm, Weight: 1.23gms, die axis: 6
